name: Al Taiseer Group TALCO Industrial Company
summary: Al Taiseer Group TALCO Industrial Company engages in the designing, manufacturing, and marketing a range of aluminum products in Oman, Kuwait, Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, the United Arab Emirates, Lebanon, and internationally. It operates through Aluminum Forming and Selling Sector; Metal Coating Powder Sector; and Other segments. The company offers aluminum extrusion, decorative surface finishes, and thermal break products.
